label: provisional internal assessment
weights_note: These are the repository assessment maxima for the eight spec criteria (25, 15, 10, 15, 10, 10, 10, 5); the organizers have not published criterion weights. This is not an independent organizer/judge result.

last_independent_assessment.status: preserved historical independent score; before P3c and P3d integrations

basis.gate_status: incomplete; no allow; six originals and set O match P3d baseline; 3 ride and 15 set F straight metrics unavailable

criteria.name: Works
criteria.attribution: Inherited P3c (+0.5) and P3d (+0.5) detector work; no P4 detector credit
criteria.reason: All eight in-envelope set O objects have a STOP. The inherited P3d STOP-keep rule raised the top object #8 from 22/124 to 51/124 STOP frames and the held-from distance from 23.9 m to 111.4 m; it still first stops at 101.3 m. Total set O inside STOP is 384/801; edge #4 is 2/83 and #6 is 6/125, with six false STOP frames on outside #7. The raw bag/cache difference and missing ride/set F remain material.

criteria.name: Range
criteria.reason: The set O top object first stops at 101.3 m; only one STOP frame is beyond 100 m. No real positive obstacle supports long-range recall, and set F straight could not be rerun.

criteria.name: Speed
criteria.reason: Native kernels remain enabled, but P4 did not conduct a new controlled stand or timing evaluation.

criteria.name: Generalisation
criteria.reason: The available six recordings were checked at 5 Hz, +3 degree roll/pitch and five start offsets, but these are already available routes. The ride is absent, and synthetic positives do not establish material robustness.

criteria.name: Technical quality
criteria.attribution: P4 data integrity, reproducibility, and evidence only
criteria.reason: All six original caches and set O cache are verified; P3d run provenance, gate output, false-alarm inventory, candidate outcomes, raw/cache sensitivity, and paired placement sample hashes are recorded. Full data-dependent gate and ride-dependent tests remain incomplete.

criteria.name: Ease of launch
criteria.reason: Existing offline image and CI evidence are unchanged; P4 did not conduct a new independent stand or operator rehearsal.

criteria.name: Team approach
criteria.attribution: P4 preregistration, transparent outcomes, and limitations
criteria.reason: P4 screened bounded A/B/C hypotheses against P3d and recorded no-target rejections plus B’s limited #4 gain. B was not accepted because the strict ride/set F gate is incomplete; no combined change was attempted.

criteria.name: Pitch
criteria.reason: No refreshed independent pitch, deck review, or rehearsal was part of this data pass.

limitations: Scores are provisional internal assessments using repository maxima, not organizer-published weights.
P3c and P3d detector changes are inherited and receive no P4 detector-improvement credit.
The ride contains no real obstacles.
Set O has been previously inspected and is not unseen validation; raw and int16 cache scores differ.
Anchored placement is based on estimated speed and near-track registration, not surveyed ground truth.
Repeated frames are not independent objects or approaches.
The incomplete full gate and missing ride-dependent pytest leave evidence gaps.
